summary: Nothing changed for EB-5 in the November 2026 Visa Bulletin. Every Final Action Date and Dates for Filing entry matches October 2026.
EB-5 Unreserved is Current (C) for All other countries, Mexico and Philippines. China (mainland-born) stays at Dec 1, 2016 and India at Dec 1, 2023 on the Final Action Dates chart.
EB-5 Rural, High Unemployment and Infrastructure set-asides are Current (C) in both charts for all five country columns.

sections.heading: EB-5 Unreserved dates held steady in November 2026
paragraphs: For EB-5 Unreserved, the Final Action Dates (Table A) did not change from October 2026 to November 2026. All other countries, Mexico and Philippines are Current (C), which means no backlog for those columns. China (mainland-born) is Dec 1, 2016 and India is Dec 1, 2023.
The Dates for Filing (Table B) for EB-5 Unreserved also did not change. All other countries, Mexico and Philippines are Current (C). China (mainland-born) is Mar 1, 2021 and India is May 1, 2024.

sections.heading: EB-5 Unreserved Table B is ahead of Table A for China and India
paragraphs: Table B dates are later than Table A dates, so they sit further ahead. For EB-5 Unreserved China (mainland-born), Table B (Mar 1, 2021) is 1551 days (≈51.0 months) ahead of Table A (Dec 1, 2016). For EB-5 Unreserved India, Table B (May 1, 2024) is 152 days (≈5.0 months) ahead of Table A (Dec 1, 2023).

USCIS says the Dates for Filing chart (Table B) is the chart to use for employment-based Form I-485 filings in November 2026. If your priority date is earlier than the Table B date for your category and country, you may be able to file your adjustment of status application this month. Other eligibility requirements still apply.

sections.heading: EB-5 Unreserved Final Action Dates over 6 and 12 months
paragraphs: For EB-5 Unreserved China (mainland-born), the Final Action Date went from Sep 22, 2016 to Dec 1, 2016 over the last 6 bulletins (since May 2026), a net +70 days (≈2.3 months). It advanced in 1 bulletin, was unchanged in 5 and retrogressed in 0. Over the last 12 bulletins (since November 2025), it went from Dec 8, 2015 to Dec 1, 2016, a net +359 days (≈11.8 months). It advanced in 5, was unchanged in 7 and retrogressed in 0.

For EB-5 Unreserved India, the Final Action Date went from May 1, 2022 to Dec 1, 2023 over the last 6 bulletins, a net +579 days (≈19.0 months). It advanced in 1, was unchanged in 4 and retrogressed in 1. Over the last 12 bulletins, it went from Feb 1, 2021 to Dec 1, 2023, a net +1033 days (≈33.9 months). It advanced in 3, was unchanged in 8 and retrogressed in 1.
EB-5 Unreserved All other countries, Mexico and Philippines were Current (C) at the start and end of both periods. Each was unchanged in 6 of 6 and 12 of 12 bulletins.

sections.heading: EB-5 Rural, High Unemployment and Infrastructure set-asides are all Current
paragraphs: EB-5 Rural (set-aside), EB-5 High Unemployment (set-aside) and EB-5 Infrastructure (set-aside) are each Current (C) in the Final Action Dates (Table A) and the Dates for Filing (Table B). That applies to All other countries, China (mainland-born), India, Mexico and Philippines. Each entry is the same as in October 2026.

For each of these three set-asides, the Table A record shows Current (C) at the start and end of the last 6 bulletins (since May 2026) and the last 12 bulletins (since November 2025). Each country column was unchanged in 6 of 6 and 12 of 12 bulletins, with no advances and no retrogressions.

faq.q: Did EB-5 dates change in the November 2026 Visa Bulletin?
faq.a: No. EB-5 Unreserved, Rural, High Unemployment and Infrastructure dates are the same as in October 2026 in both Table A (Final Action Dates) and Table B (Dates for Filing), for every country column listed.

faq.q: What is the EB-5 Unreserved Final Action Date for China and India in November 2026?
faq.a: For EB-5 Unreserved, the Final Action Date is Dec 1, 2016 for China (mainland-born) and Dec 1, 2023 for India. Both are unchanged from October 2026. All other countries, Mexico and Philippines are Current (C).

faq.q: Which chart does USCIS use for EB-5 Form I-485 in November 2026?
faq.a: USCIS says employment-based applicants use the Dates for Filing chart (Table B) for November 2026. If your priority date is earlier than the Table B date for your category and country, you may be able to file. Other eligibility requirements still apply.

faq.q: How far ahead is Table B for EB-5 Unreserved?
faq.a: For EB-5 Unreserved China (mainland-born), Table B is 1551 days (≈51.0 months) ahead of Table A. For India, it is 152 days (≈5.0 months) ahead. All other countries, Mexico and Philippines are Current (C) in both tables.
